cohort: 200 pregnant women scheduled for elective cesarean section
finding: Prophylactic cefepime administration pre- and post-cesarean delivery significantly reduced the incidence of post-operative wound infection and endometritis compared to ampicillin/sulbactam.
mod_finding: Prophylactic cefepime administration pre- and post-cesarean delivery significantly reduced the incidence of post-operative wound infection and endometritis compared to ampicillin/sulbactam.
